description: DRAFT — not frozen, tag aegis-day30 not cut. Signed provenance attestation for the AEGIS Day-30 gate (2026-10-27). 'Valid shape' for tamper case TC-SIG-FORGE means validating against this schema. Field mapping to interlock Claim: statement ~ text, provenance ~ provenance, issuer ~ authority holder. Signature covers the canonical bytes: UTF-8 JSON of this object with keys sorted lexicographically and separators (',', ':'), excluding the 'signature' field. The verify contract (writer pen) implements shape validation by hand — the SDK stays zero-dependency like interlock, so this document is the normative shape, not a runtime-validated artifact.

issuer.description: The holder/agent issuing the attestation — ties to interlock's lease authority model.

key_id.description: Identifies the key the verify path is required to check.

provenance.description: What produced the statement (tool, process, agent path).

sig_alg.description: Signature algorithm name. DRAFT default: Ed25519. Fixed at the gate tag, not here.

signature.description: Base64-encoded signature over the canonical bytes defined above.
